name: io.identityforge/mcp
title: Identity Forge
description: Design kits, brand naming, and domain research for coding agents.

packageArguments.description: Run the MCP server over stdio

environmentVariables.name: IDENTITYFORGE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Identity Forge API key (ifk_…). Optional for browsing free kits; required for Pro kits, naming boards, and writes. Run `npx --yes identityforge@latest login`; if you need an account, browser signup asks you to confirm your email and then resumes authorization. A confirmed account enables persistent projects, saved work, and authenticated quota.
